name: furnlight-simple
description: Simple ladder for the item-as-light-source feature (PARITY-FURNLIGHT, itemAsLight flag, simple tier): confirms it's on by default in Simple mode, places a plain non-fixture item (a dresser — not in LIGHT_EMITTERS), flips the REAL inspector 'Make a light source' icon-button (only reachable inside the per-room editor), then EXITS the room editor to verify it actually emits in the real Scene (store props.lightOn + a live scene-graph PointLight probe, since the per-room editor's own Canvas — RoomEditorScene.tsx — has a fixed flat hemisphere+ambient rig and does not render FurnitureLights at all, so the light is invisible while still inside the editor) — screenshots lit vs unlit in both orbit and walk mode. NOTE: at the time this was written there is no shipped walk-mode E-key light-toggle interaction and no 'walkLights' flag — TASKS.md queues 'Interactable lights' as future work (see report) — so this rung exercises the inspector toggle, the only shipped light-source-toggle UI. The 'Turn off light source' path clicks the REAL button (regression guard for the fixed merge-can't-clear updateItemProps bug).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(19.5); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); })()

steps.name: verify-scenegraph-lit

waitFor.store: (() => { const it = state.items.find((i) => i.id === 'furnlight-dresser'); if (!it || it.props.lightOn !== 'yes') return false; const scene = window.__three && window.__three.scene; if (!scene) return false; let found = false; scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.isPointLight && Math.abs(o.position.x - 9.6) < 0.8 && Math.abs(o.position.z - 2.6) < 0.8 && o.intensity > 0) found = true; }); return found; })()

steps.comment_not_a_step_key_see_report: Fixed bug regression guard: this used to be a store-level workaround because updateItemProps only merged (a deleted key could never clear). updateItemProps now removes explicitly-undefined keys and the header passes { lightOn: undefined }, so the REAL button click must clear the prop.

steps.name: verify-scenegraph-unlit

waitFor.store: (() => { const it = state.items.find((i) => i.id === 'furnlight-dresser'); if (it && it.props.lightOn === 'yes') return false; const scene = window.__three && window.__three.scene; if (!scene) return true; let found = false; scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.isPointLight && Math.abs(o.position.x - 9.6) < 0.8 && Math.abs(o.position.z - 2.6) < 0.8 && o.intensity > 0) found = true; }); return !found; })()
